trigger.title: Form submission
trigger.subtitle: Start automation when {{form}} is Completed
trigger.subtitleResponseEdited: Start automation when a response to {{form}} is edited

trigger.description: This automation starts every time someone completes this form.
trigger.descriptionResponseEdited: This automation starts every time a response to this form is edited.
trigger.descriptionSchedule: This automation starts on the schedule below — it doesn't have a triggering response, so steps can't reference response fields.

schedule.invalidCron: Enter a valid 5-field cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * *".
schedule.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, e.g. "America/Chicago".
schedule.hint: Times are evaluated in the timezone above (defaults to UTC if left blank).
schedule.appliesOnPublish: Changes are saved automatically and take effect when you publish.

end.description: The automation finishes here — nothing runs after this step.

action.noConfigForm: This action can't be configured yet.
action.unappliedDescription: You've edited this step but haven't applied the changes.

delay.hint: The next step runs after this delay has passed.

digest.hint: Each run picks up only the responses no earlier run has processed yet, so nothing gets emailed or processed twice. Add a Condition step next to skip the rest when there's nothing new — check "New responses count".
digest.noFiltersHint: No filters — every new response is included. Add a filter to narrow it down (e.g. only a specific tag or score range).
digest.includeExistingLabel: Also include responses submitted before this automation is switched on
digest.includeExistingHint: Off by default: the first run starts from the moment you activate this automation, so existing responses are left alone.
digest.includeExistingWarning: The first run will process every response that matches your filters above — including ones submitted long before this automation existed. If a step below emails each response, every one of those people will be emailed on the first run.

condition.noRulesHint: Add at least one rule. Responses matching it follow the Yes branch; everything else follows No.

saveStatus.offline: Offline. Changes kept on this device.

discardDialog.title: Discard unpublished changes?
discardDialog.description: The builder will reset to the live version (v{{version}}). This can't be undone.

conflict.title: This automation was edited elsewhere
conflict.leaveConfirm: This automation was edited elsewhere, so your latest edits can't be saved. If you leave now they will be lost. Leave anyway?

builder.readOnlyDraftNotice: An editor has unpublished changes to this automation.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.description: Runs appear here once this automation is triggered by a form submission or a test run.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this run?
cancelConfirm.description: This stops the run at its current step. Steps that already completed aren't undone.

detail.skippedNoReason: This scheduled run was skipped because a previous run was still in progress.
